summary: Fetched complete copies for four stored documents flagged as incomplete. Panama gazette 30140-B: the stored PDF was already complete (identical to the official file; the earlier ledger misread p. 12), so no new copy; two restated rules and one event added. Qatar Law 10/2018: full article texts obtained from Al Meezan with curl and stored; 7 rules added. Egypt ECU FAQ: page 2 obtained (via the site's pager post-back) and stored; nothing new in scope, and 4 of the 15 counted items still cannot be reached. Canada BIP evaluation: chapters 2, 3, 6 and Appendices A-F stored; 342 Investor-class figures and 3 rules added.

sources.title: قانون رقم (10) لسنة 2018 بشأن الإقامة الدائمة (Law No. (10) of 2018 on Permanent Residence), full text view
sources.covers: Law card (law no. 10, 13 articles, in force; Official Gazette no. 15 of 21/10/2018, p. 3), preamble and the texts of all 13 articles: eligibility (20 years' residence if born abroad, 10 if born in Qatar; 60 days a year absence allowed; income, conduct, Arabic), exempt categories, the granting committee, annual cap of 100 persons (art. 4), privileges (travel, state health and education, investment without a Qatari partner, property ownership), family (spouse; children to 18, sons at university to 25, unmarried daughters), fees set by ministerial decision, withdrawal.
sources.notes: Fetched with curl on 2026-10-10 (the 2026-10-02 attempt had hit a firewall page). This is the portal's "view whole law" page (LawView.aspx), which holds every article; the Word export (LawViewWord.aspx) returned the same HTML and the PDF link (LocalPdfLaw.aspx) returned an empty page. The page says the displayed text should not be considered official ("الرجاء عدم اعتبار المادة المعروضة أعلاه رسمية") and carries a general "all rights reserved" notice of the Government of Qatar; no term found that forbids reproducing legislation (the earlier copy from the same portal is already stored). Same Hijri/Gregorian mismatch on the law card as the earlier copy (04/09/2018 shown with 13/12/1438).

sources.title: الأسئلة المتكررة (FAQ), page 2 of 2
sources.publisher: Prime Minister's Office (Cabinet), Unit for Examining Naturalisation Applications, ecu.gov.eg
sources.covers: Page 2 of the programme FAQ: five items, four of them identical to items already on page 1 (revocation within 10/5 years, citizenship permanent, children and grandchildren, dual nationality) and one new item (how to follow up an application: written preliminary approval after applying and paying the administrative fee; call centre).
sources.notes: Page 2 is served only after a form post-back (the site's own pager button: POST to the same URL with _StandardPaging_PageIndex=1); fetched with curl, no access control involved. It cannot be archived by the Wayback Machine (POST); a Wayback capture of page 1 exists (https://web.archive.org/web/20260422021744/https://www.ecu.gov.eg/ECI/FQA/List.aspx). The pager prints "[15 عناصر]" but pages 1 and 2 together show only 11 different questions: page 2 repeated the same four page-1 items on four separate fetches, which suggests the list is paged without a stable order, so up to four items may not be reachable through the pager. Changing the page size (the site's App_Utility/Paging.aspx) had no effect.
